t: Erbauer ECCD18-Li 18V combi drill delivers high performance for drilling and hammer drilling applications in wood, steel, and masonry. Highly suited for electricians, plumbers, and DIYers working in tight spaces, the compact cordless tool measures only 164mm in length. Features brushless motor technology to provide increased run time, greater power, and longer tool life. Variable speed settings and 19 torque stages offer precise control for diverse driving tasks, whilst a built-in LED work light illuminates dark work areas. A fan-cooled motor helps prevent overheating during heavy use, ensuring reliable performance on site, and the electronic brake stops the motor quickly for added safety and speed. Suitable for drilling in wood, steel and masonry. Supplied with 2.0Ah battery, charger and belt clip. Compatible with all Erbauer EXT 18V batteries.
